How Best ROI is ranked

High priority before medium before low. Within each priority, overdue tasks come first, then available XP per estimated hour, then earlier due dates. Effort time estimates are Small: 15 min, Medium: 45 min, Large: 2 hours, Major: 4 hours. Already-rewarded tasks have no new XP return. This estimates game rewards, not business impact or measured productivity. Grouping may arrange the displayed tasks into sections; the top five are selected across all matching tasks.

Weeks start Monday. Dates use this machine’s local time. Deleting a task preserves its history.

How these metrics are calculated
  • Daily periods use local calendar dates. Weeks run Monday to Sunday. Current periods show results so far; future periods have no actual activity yet.
  • Each task is counted on its first completion only. Reopening and completing it again does not inflate output or XP. Completed tasks remain counted if later deleted.
  • On-time rate = first completions on or before their deadline ÷ all first completions in the period. No completions displays a dash. Deadline changes made after a due day do not erase a missed deadline.
  • XP is attributed to when it was first awarded; later edits and reward redemption do not change this value. Focus time sums finished session durations, not time the app was open or estimated task effort.
  • Overdue carryover is reconstructed at the end of a past period, or now for the current period. Tasks deleted or completed before that cutoff are excluded. It includes overdue tasks carried from earlier periods.
  • Category filters use the current category assignment. For old records without detailed date-change or status history, the stored values are used as a fallback.

Tasks, rewards, focus sessions and credit transactions are saved in this browser. Export a backup to move them to another browser or machine.

Import replaces this browser’s data after confirmation. Export your current data first. Devices don’t automatically synchronize.

Keep this app on the same address and port to keep using its saved data. Private browsing or clearing site data can remove it.

New mission

Effort is an estimate, independent of the focus timer. First completion earns 10 credits. Reopening a task keeps its earned XP and credits; completing it again grants no additional reward.

Manage categories

Create or rename categories. Deleting a category moves its tasks to another category; no tasks are deleted. Keep at least one category.

Delete category

Completed and deleted task records are also reassigned. Their previous category remains in the activity log.

Review overdue tasks

Decide what matters next. Update the priority and reschedule each task; its previous due date stays in the activity log. No overdue penalties are applied.
